facts.claim: Chronic unpredictable mild stress failed to affect hippocampal volume in rats.
facts.quote: Moreover, we found an increased hippocampal volume in rats exposed to CMS after clomipramine treatment while CMS failed to affect hippocampal volume.

facts.claim: Chronic social defeat stress caused a significant increase in left hippocampal volume in resilient mice, but not in susceptible mice.
facts.quote: After chronic social defeat stress, we found significant increases in left hippocampal volume in resilient and nonstressed control mice. Intriguingly, this increase in hippocampal volume was not found in susceptible mice
facts.causalWarning: causal wording, but the cited study only shows an association

facts.claim: No association was observed between maternal cortisol in pregnancy and child hippocampus volume in either sex.
facts.quote: No association between maternal cortisol in pregnancy and child hippocampus volume was observed in either sex.

facts.claim: Chronic stress-induced atrophy of hippocampal astrocyte size is associated with decreased glycogen content.
facts.quote: Results suggest that decreased glycogen content was associated with chronic stress-induced atrophy of hippocampal astrocyte size and depression-like behavior.

facts.claim: Prolactin protects neurogenesis in the dentate gyrus of chronically stressed mice and promotes neuronal fate.
facts.quote: The results demonstrate that PRL protects neurogenesis in the DG of chronically stressed mice and promotes neuronal fate.

facts.claim: Chronic stress causes a reduction in hippocampal volume.
facts.quote: Chronic exposure to stress results in a reduction of hippocampal neurogenesis and of hippocampal volume.

research.angle: While some experiments show chronic stress reduces hippocampal volume, other studies show it may have no effect on volume or even lead to volume increases in resilient subjects.
research.verdict: The evidence is mixed, showing that chronic stress can reduce hippocampal volume in some contexts but does not consistently cause it across all subjects or conditions.
research.caveat: The findings vary significantly depending on the specific type of stressor, the species studied, and whether the subjects are susceptible or resilient to the stress.
